insight: Talents no longer require a skill point to level. You automatically get a talent at level 10 when you level a skill, eliminating the old pattern of delaying level 10 talents until level 16.
Assist gold has been significantly reduced, especially early game. Lane creeps are now even more important to farm. Prioritize clearing lane creeps over relying on assist gold.

Flag bearer creeps grant 4% magic resistance aura to all creeps after 7:30 minutes (stacking to 8% at 15min, 12% at 22min). Magic damage nukes will deal less damage to creep waves with a flag bearer as the game progresses.

Illusions now give flat 800 daytime and 400 nighttime vision regardless of hero bonuses. They no longer work with Diffusal Blade mana burn. Illusions take significantly less extra damage from sources like Radiance burn.
Hand of Midas no longer grants experience multiplier, only gold with lower cooldown. It takes 21 minutes for Midas to pay for itself purely through gold generation.
Battle Hunger is now pure damage and significantly reduced in damage. Axe is much weaker in laning and scaling. Core build should shift back to Blade Mail + Call focus rather than stat items.
Clinkz regained Searing Arrows. New innate causes him and skeletons to pierce enemy armor. This enhances farming and single-target damage significantly.

Bear is now innate with separate stat gains and talent tree. Entangle is now controllable (5 hits in 10 seconds on heroes) instead of RNG. Hero skill has separate castable entangle. Consider itemizing on both hero and bear.
Core Mirana build: Kayasha + Ethereal Blade + stat items. Arrow now shoots starstorm (AGS effect), and starstorm damage talent moved to level 20, dramatically improving farming speed.
Adaptive Strike regained the mini-stun, enabling TP cancels on carry Morphling.
Blink now has two charges on longer cooldown instead of one charge.
Innate changed and no longer benefits from bonus damage. Hero feels awkward and likely weaker. Avoid until playstyle is discovered.

Essence Shift is now innate (level 1). New ability Saltwater Shiv provides free aggro-free harass every 10s, healing 19 HP and reducing enemy regen by 3. Slark has significantly better level 1 kill threat and laning trades.
Reverted to agility hero with old Haunt. Desolate is innate. Lacks clear identity now due to high mana costs, need to farm and sustain, and loss of low-cooldown pickoff potential.
Illusions no longer have damage penalty when near you (60% bonus), but Conjure Image damage heavily reduced (56% near, 35% away vs old 75%/24%). Illusions no longer grant vision.

Leech Seed is now attack modifier that heals based on damage and prevents aggro. Nature's Grasp innate provides free tree invis utility. Aghanim's Scepter grants 100% strength bonus and splash damage on Overgrowth (60s cooldown). Build Strength + Blink + Black King Bar.

Shard no longer grants Enrage but applies 3 Fury Swipe stacks in large AoE. Increases mid-to-late game damage but removes the extra fight duration Enrage provided. Explore new playstyles with this change.
Shared Tango healing halved. Supports should no longer give tangos to carries unless critical. Healing supports are now buffed.
Nullifier now applies basic dispel to enemies. Can dispel Ghost Scepter and Glimmer Cape defensively.
Ethereal Blade component changed from Ether Lens to Ultimate Orb. Now based on caster's attributes instead of target's primary attribute. Builds heavily around stat stacking with Ethereal Blade.
Heart of Tarrasque buffed below 73% HP, nearly doubling healing when very low HP.
Radiance no longer has aura burn damage, only 25% evasion for holder. Significant nerf to the item.
Duelist Glove (tier 1): Gives 140 physical damage barrier to hero and all friendly units on 6s duration, 40s cooldown. Excellent on summon heroes.
Weighted Dice (tier 1): Roll base damage and creep gold twice, take highest value. Grants most heroes 1-2 bonus damage and 1-2 gold per last hit on average.
Water areas added near defender gates on both Radiant and Dire providing movement speed bonus to access nearby camps.
Four jungle camps changed from large to medium: one near Radiant tier 1, one near Dire tier 1, and both triangle camps on each side.
New walkways added next to tier 1 towers on both sides. Dead ends replaced with escape routes, making side lane ganks significantly harder.
Observer Ward nighttime vision reduced from 800 to 450. Watcher placement slightly adjusted on both sides of map.
Twin Gates cost reduced to 30 mana (from 70) with mana refund on cancel. Free trial on teleport cast. Significantly easier early game rotation.

Urn of Shadows and Spirit Vessel: Multiple Urns on same team all gain charges from kills within radius. Only one Spirit Vessel per team gains charges. Can have one Vessel + four Urns all gaining charges.
Abilities and items like Nullifier can no longer target heroes during Eul's Scepter invulnerability. Cast Eul's before Nullifier is cast to avoid being pulled down. Major buff to Eul's utility.
